alerts.title: Hypothyroidism Uncontrolled With Missed Levothyroxine Doses
alerts.message: Patient on levothyroxine 50 mcg with TSH 12.4 mIU/L (target below 4.5) and low free T4, with clinical features of hypothyroidism (fatigue, cold intolerance, constipation, dry skin, periorbital puffiness, delayed ankle reflex relaxation) plus reported non-adherence to the thyroid tablet. Weight gain of about 9 kg over the past year may be partly due to hypothyroidism rather than DTG, which is not established by the guideline excerpts. The clinician plan continues levothyroxine unchanged without addressing adherence or dose adjustment.

evidence.recommended_action: Address levothyroxine adherence and review the thyroid dose with repeat TFTs per the clinician's judgement before attributing weight gain to DTG; reassess before any ART switch.

alerts.title: Weight Gain on DTG: Evaluate Before Switching
alerts.message: Guidelines note that DTG-associated weight gain is comparatively less metabolic than older regimens and that the association may not be causal, while abnormal weight gain is listed as a DTG adverse effect to be recorded. Patient has BMI 33 and 9 kg gain over one year, with co-existing hypothyroidism and amitriptyline (which can contribute to weight gain). Fasting glucose 5.6 mmol/L, LDL 4.2 mmol/L, total cholesterol 6.4 mmol/L and triglycerides 2.3 mmol/L are noted; the patient has several hyperglycaemia risk factors (age 45, BMI at or above 25, BP 128/82).

evidence.recommended_action: Before switching from DTG, correct hypothyroidism, review amitriptyline contribution, and monitor glucose; document weight gain as a possible adverse effect and reassess.

alerts.title: Viral Load Monitoring Due on DTG-Based ART
alerts.message: Guidelines recommend viral load checks every 6 months on DTG-based first-line ART. Last viral load <50 copies/mL was on 2025-11-10 (106 days before the visit), so the next check is not yet due, but the plan does not document scheduling. Ongoing weight-gain concerns and adherence issues may affect viral suppression.

evidence.recommended_action: Schedule viral load monitoring at 6-monthly intervals on DTG-based ART, with enhanced adherence support if adherence problems persist.
